chunks: God will rescue those who fear Him by their victory; no evil will touch them, nor will they grieve.
ai.seo_question: What is the fate of those who fear God according to Surah Az-Zumar?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'mafazatuhum' (their deliverance) is often interpreted as the ultimate success of attaining proximity to God, where the soul is liberated from the dominion of the ego and minor sins. This verse underscores the dual assurance of the muttaqun: freedom from external afflictions ('la yamassuhumu as-su') and internal tranquility ('wa la hum yahzanun'), reflecting the complete peace of the heart in the presence of the Divine. It serves as a spiritual benchmark for believers, linking their earthly piety to an eternal state of joyous serenity.
